opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that can evidence delivery of outstanding quality teaching within their field.
opportunities.summary: For specialist arts institutions or registered charities to provide training opportunities across the fine and performing arts (music, drama, dance, film, fine art, etc.) for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: maximum total award of £475,000; bursaries £5,000‑£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that can demonstrate outstanding quality teaching and offer undergraduate or postgraduate degrees in the fine and performing arts.
opportunities.summary: For specialist arts institutions or charities to provide bursaries of £5,000‑£10,000 a year per student to support undergraduate and postgraduate students across the fine and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 salary contribution year 1; £28,000 year 2‑3; up to £6,000 research expenses per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK, hold a doctorate, and have submitted their thesis for viva by the closing date.
opportunities.summary: For early‑career researchers, with a research record but who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post, to undertake a significant piece of publishable work.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from a UK university position, live in the UK ≥26 weeks per year, and have an established research record.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (or consortia of up to two such universities). Applications are made by the university, not by individual students.
opportunities.summary: The Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships provide up to 30 doctoral scholarships (plus additional master‑plus‑PhD and post‑doctoral opportunities) for UK universities in interdisciplinary priority research areas.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: up to £10 million over up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (registered with the Office for Students and holding research degree‑awarding powers). Centres may be single‑institution or collaborative.
opportunities.summary: Funding for UK universities to set up Leverhulme Research Centres for outstanding original research with a step‑change impact; outline applications due June 2027.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: research expenses up to £6,000 per year; salary contribution covers replacement salary costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences, employed at an eligible UK university, not required to hold a professorial title.
opportunities.summary: For well‑established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences to complete a piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with at least two years post‑PhD experience, holding a permanent UK university appointment at lecturer level or nominated by a university.
opportunities.summary: Centenary Research Leadership Awards support talented early‑career scholars to build a research team and demonstrate research leadership, with awards of up to £1 million over 4‑5 years.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK higher‑education institutions, and on a trial basis UK‑based independent research institutes/organisations.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project (grant up to five years).
discipline_tags: all disciplines except excluded medical/clinical areas

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university (or specialist arts institution) with research degree‑awarding powers, acting as host; the visiting professor is an eminent senior professor from overseas.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring novel expertise and enhance skills/knowledge in an under‑represented research area.
